text: In the order of the verses, and not too long, in the auspicious and well-formed calves of the one who is the creator of the remaining limbs, the Maker, as it were, exerted himself to produce beauty. The hands of the Lord of Serpents, due to their roughness and extreme coolness, are like a particular kind of banana; having obtained this form in the world, they are born above that, beyond the scope of comparison. By this much, it can be inferred that the beauty of the inferable, the place of the qualities of the gem, which is without fault, has been attributed by the Lord of the Mountain (Shiva) afterwards to the limb that is delightful to no other woman.
